items.title: Sound perception and word recognition
items.expectation: Recognise selected contrasts and familiar words across routine voices and generally clear delivery.
items.exit_boundary: Generally understandable in familiar situations, though repetition and listener effort may be needed.

items.title: Consonant contrasts and place or manner clarity
items.expectation: Maintain selected contrasts in routine phrases and short sentences, with repetition available when needed.
items.exit_boundary: Generally understandable in familiar situations, though repetition and listener effort may be needed.

items.title: Vowel contrasts and reduced vowels
items.expectation: Maintain selected vowel contrasts in routine words and phrases and begin recognising common unstressed vowels.
items.exit_boundary: Generally understandable in familiar situations, though repetition and listener effort may be needed.

items.title: Syllable shape, consonant clusters, and word endings
items.expectation: Produce common initial and final clusters without additions or losses that disrupt routine understanding.
items.exit_boundary: Generally understandable in familiar situations, though repetition and listener effort may be needed.

items.title: Audible grammatical endings
items.expectation: Distinguish common -s and -ed forms in routine production and recognise their main pronunciation patterns.
items.exit_boundary: Generally understandable in familiar situations, though repetition and listener effort may be needed.

items.title: Word stress and stress-sensitive recognition
items.expectation: Use expected stress in a wider routine repertoire and notice stress changes in common related words.
items.exit_boundary: Generally understandable in familiar situations, though repetition and listener effort may be needed.

items.title: Sentence prominence and rhythm
items.expectation: Highlight key content words and reduce some predictable function words in routine short utterances.
items.exit_boundary: Generally understandable in familiar situations, though repetition and listener effort may be needed.

items.title: Connected-speech perception and production
items.expectation: Understand common routine linking and reductions and use selected forms without losing key words.
items.exit_boundary: Generally understandable in familiar situations, though repetition and listener effort may be needed.

items.title: Intonation, interaction, and stance
items.expectation: Use basic contours for statements, questions, continuation, politeness, and routine turn-taking.
items.exit_boundary: Generally understandable in familiar situations, though repetition and listener effort may be needed.

items.title: Chunking, pausing, monitoring, and pronunciation repair
items.expectation: Group short sentences into clear units and use repetition, slower delivery, or rewording in routine repair.
items.exit_boundary: Generally understandable in familiar situations, though repetition and listener effort may be needed.
